proposal.label: needs more info
proposal.comment: Could you share how DuckDB was installed on the Windows host (e.g. `pip` wheel, `conda`, or built from source) and paste the output of `import duckdb; print(duckdb.__version__, duckdb.__file__)`? Also please include the complete crash output or Windows Event Viewer error/stack trace shown when the Python process exits after the interrupt.
proposal.rationale: The report includes a self-contained MRE and environment, but it lacks the DuckDB binary/install provenance and the crash log/stack trace from Windows; those details are essential to reproduce and diagnose a process-level access violation on interrupt.
